propositions: The rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded in _step0_names() instead of derived, so a classified mutating method can be renamed or moved outside the swept transport modules without the completeness assertion detecting drift.

Scanning all 8 unswept Jira adapter modules for names colliding with _CLASSIFIED_MUTATING yields exactly 2 definitions (backend.py::set_relationship and backend.py::add_comment), both of which are pure same-name delegations to self.transport.
An anti-drift guard must accept only pure same-name self.transport delegations with arguments forwarded unchanged, rejecting guards, retries, logging, transforms, or dropped arguments.

The sweep's scoping to four transport modules is correct and should not be widened to the entire 12-module Jira package via glob, which would demand individual 429-policy classification of 90 unrelated members.
